subject.title: ACP session identity stuck in "pending" state after gateway restart storm, causing messages to be unrouted to bound ACP agent

question: Should ACP restart recovery preserve ensure-sourced IDs as provisional and add status/liveness-backed persistent-session recovery, or treat pending identities with stable IDs as resolved?
rationale: The report is credible from source inspection, but changing persisted identity semantics affects ACP session-state compatibility and overlaps an open warm-restore PR with unresolved session-state blockers.

options.title: Status-Backed Recovery
options.body: Keep ensure IDs provisional, add persistent-session recovery that probes or recreates live runtime state, and require configured-channel restart proof.

options.title: Resolve Pending IDs
options.body: Treat pending identities with stable IDs as resolved immediately, accepting the risk that stale ensure IDs become authoritative.

options.title: Defer To Warm Restore
options.body: Wait for the open warm-restore/PID-liveness PR to be repaired and then decide whether it fully covers this issue.

recommendation.title: Status-Backed Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ensure IDs provisional, add persistent-session recovery that probes or recreates live runtime state, and require configured-channel restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on ACP control-plane extraction, runtime-handle ensure, resume-state recovery, and identity helpers.
